# cloudaxion_floating_ip_assignment (Resource)

Binds a `cloudaxion_floating_ip` to a virtual machine, managed service or load balancer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudaxion_floating_ip_assignment" "egress" {
  address     = cloudaxion_floating_ip.egress.address
  resource_id = cloudaxion_vm.node.id
  # resource_type defaults to "virtual_machine"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) The floating IP address to bind.
- `resource_id` (String) UUID of the resource to bind the address to.

### Optional

- `location` (String) Location slug. Defaults to the provider's `location`.
- `resource_type` (String) Kind of resource: `virtual_machine` (the default), `service` or `load_balancer`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier, `address:resource_id`.
- `private_ip` (String) Private address the floating IP maps to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cloudaxion_floating_ip_assignment.egress tun01/203.0.113.10:6c772f89-d00c-4d41-8acd-0202599c4ed3
```
